Intro: Your establishment has been remarkably compliant with new safety protocols regarding Spoilage.
My officers have been singing your praises. I've come to see for myself, and to try some of your cooking.
Your identification of those who are Spoiled has been so accurate, I half-considered offering you a position in my ranks.
Though I'm sure your adoring customers would submit complaints if I whisked their beloved chef away to the military.
Your adherence to the rules is truly remarkable. People like you will never stray from the status quo.
I congratulate you on your success, and wish you many more years of happiness.
Success: I can see why your patrons return. This meal is satisfactory.
You're awfully quiet, aren't you? Complacent and docile, happy to follow the rules, and never stray.
Hah. If I were like you, perhaps this world would be a lot different. But I should be grateful you don't make my job difficult.
I'll be sure to have the soldiers come by to eat sometime.
You've done a great service to the people of Verehn.
Fail: Hm. Neither sweet, nor salty, nor bitter.
Tasteless. Like it's nothing at all, and cannot decide whether it wants to be something.
Oh, there's nothing wrong. It is just how people are. It is rather difficult to pick sides in a war where no one wins, now isn't it?
My thanks for indulging me in this. But I'll have to shut this establishment down. It's not compliant with our Spoilage policy.
You may join the queue of others looking for work in this city at the Capitol.

Success: There is no need for bribery. Proffering dessert after already being heaped with praise is excessive.
Though, this is a beautifully crafted dessert. It almost…reminds me of something.
I suppose I shouldn't turn down your generosity.
…it tastes of a memory that I cannot quite remember. But—something is different. There is something…bitter.
I was—wrong about you. You writhing, helpless thing.
No—matter. Watch this world fall apart without me—let them parade my corpse down the street.
